name: A Soul's Price
source:
You are Cordelia Kennett, a graduate student in philosophy finishing up your final year with a thesis at ES University. You've been waiting eagerly for a grant to get the project going and this Fall semester it finally happens--$5000 to fund your thesis titled 'A Soul's Price: The Moral Dilemma of Selling Your Soul.'

You have two big campus events to buy up as many souls as you can: Homecoming and the Fall Farmer's Market. All with the help of your best friend, Shirley, of course. Will Cordelia get 500 people to sign their souls away for money? Or is the human heart not as fickle as you think?

But...buying the souls isn't the only thing Cordelia is doing for the project. No, owning souls is just step one. Step two is far more risky and...reckless. 

A Soul's Price is a philosophical thriller that explores the realms of belief, religious ideology, and moral conundrums to figure out what kind of world we live in...and what kind of god runs it.

[From [url=https://skyeroze.itch.io/a-souls-price]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是Cordelia Kennett，一名哲学研究生，在ES大学完成了最后一年的论文。你一直在热切地等待一笔资助来启动这个项目，今年秋季学期终于实现了——5000美元资助你的论文，题为“灵魂的代价：出卖灵魂的道德困境”。

你有两个大型校园活动来购买尽可能多的灵魂：返校节和秋季农贸市场。当然，这一切都得益于你最好的朋友雪莉的帮助。科迪莉亚能否让500人签下灵魂换取金钱？还是人心并没有你想象的那么善变？

但是……购买灵魂并不是科迪莉亚为该项目所做的唯一事情。不，拥有灵魂只是第一步。第二步风险更大，而且……鲁莽。

《灵魂的代价》是一部哲学惊悚片，探索信仰、宗教意识形态和道德难题的领域，以弄清楚我们生活在一个什么样的世界……以及统治这个世界的上帝是什么样的。

[来自[url=https://skyeroze.itch.io/a-souls-price]itch.io[/url]]
